judged_text: symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse on the keys payload are unguarded, so a payload encrypted with a mismatched CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY (or corrupt ciphertext) throws inside the handler. A parent app whose encryption key doesn't match gets an unhandled 500 with no indication the failure is a key mismatch — while every other client error gets a structured 4xx — making the credential-sync integration undiagnosable.

adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch. If ciphertext is corrupt or encrypted with a different key than `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `symmetricDecrypt` and/or `JSON.parse` can throw, causing the API route to error out with an unstructured 500. This is inconsistent with the route’s other explicit 4xx error responses (invalid secret, missing user/app), and would make key-mismatch failures hard to diagnose.
